text:
sara: heads up — high-sev customer escalation. tool-calling is failing for AcmeCorp since ~2026-03-15 18:00 UTC. they see schema validation errors and functions are not being selected. raising to eng.

sara: error they're hitting from the API (redacted ids):
```
HTTP 400
{
  "error": "SchemaValidationError",
  "message": "tools[0].args: expected OBJECT but got STRING",
  "request_id": "rq_3F4bX..."
}
```

sara: customer sent the request body they used (trimmed):
```
POST /v1/responses
{
  "model": "rdw-llamaf-13b",
  "input": "Generate SQL",
  "tool_calls": [
    {
      "tool": "db_query",
      "args": "SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=123"
    }
  ]
}
```

sara: note args is a string in the payload, but our tool schema expects an object: {query: string, options?: {limit:int}}. This used to be accepted earlier (customer says started failing after deploy).

sara: created Zendesk ticket #12345 and attached request_id + logs. support-bot: ticket created -> #12345.

sara: customer reports impact: production searches failing, several tickets opened. latency spikes also observed when tool-calling attempted.

josh: assigning to eng-ml runtime team to triage. can someone reproduce locally with the exact payload?

mike: taking this. quick question — which model variant is the customer using? you noted rdw-llamaf-13b, any quantized variant?

sara: they are on rdw-llamaf-13b:fp16 in Dedicated US-EAST. no custom wrappers.

josh: ok. first hypothesis: schema validation stricter in the new schema enforcement change from last week (PR #4123). could be a regression in our tool-call coercion layer that used to coerce string->object for legacy clients.

eva: I can run the toolcall schema test suite locally. which CI test started failing? eng-ci-bot posted a failing job earlier: toolcall_schema_suite/test_mixed_args on main at commit 8a7d2f3.

eng-ci-bot: CI failure detected — job: toolcall_schema_suite/test_mixed_args (main, 8a7d2f3). link: https://ci.redwood/teams/eng-ml/jobs/6543

mike: repro steps I used: curl + exact body -> got same 400 with SchemaValidationError. Dropped into runtime logs and found: 
```
runtime: validate_tools -> raise ValidationError('tools[0].args expected dict')
stack: runtime/toolcall/validator.py:134
```

mike: interestingly, earlier we had a compatibility shim in validator.py that would try json.loads if args was a string. looks like PR #4123 removed that shim.

josh: if PR #4123 intentionally tightened validation, we need a migration plan — but this is a production break for customers sending string args. short-term: route AcmeCorp traffic to compatibility model variant or temporarily revert the change in Dedicated for that customer. Long-term: update docs + run evals to catch this.

josh: Action items: 1) mike to rollout rollback or route traffic (temp), 2) eva to add golden prompts to the toolcall schema eval suite and create a CI gate, 3) eng-ml to decide if we keep strict validation.

mike: implementing quick mitigation — adding a per-customer request transform to coerce string args into {query: args} for db_query. Pushing a hotfix to Dedicated config for AcmeCorp now. Will post deploy ts.

mike: deploy done to AcmeCorp pool at 2026-03-16T02:12:10Z — they confirm errors dropped to 0. :thumbsup:

eva: I'll add a new test case to the eval harness: golden_prompt_toolcall_acme_db_query.json which submits the legacy string arg and asserts the call is routed and schema recognized. I'll also add this to CI as a failing test that must pass before merging any schema-enforcement PRs.

eva: note: the existing test suite has unit tests but not golden end-to-end checks that run on real model variants. I propose a small matrix: [model_variant x tool_schema_compat_mode].

josh: please link the PRs and CI job. we need a postmortem note for the customer and an internal changelog entry. Also flag to docs to add a deprecation notice with a 30-day migration window if we plan to keep strict validation.

eng-ci-bot: created issue: GH-785 (add golden prompt + CI gate) and queued job: toolcall_golden_matrix/6544

mike: PR opened for hotfix route: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/438 (temp shim). rolling to other impacted customers after we confirm no side effects.

mike: quick telemetry note — latency spike during failing calls looks tied to repeated validation attempts; when we coerced back it removed the extra 200ms per call.

josh: thanks all. next steps: eva to finish test + PR 24h, eng-ml to decide policy on strictness, mike to document hotfix and schedule proper rollback plan if we decide to keep shim. I'll prepare customer-facing postmortem and send to CSM.

support-bot: ticket #12345 updated: status -> awaiting_eng_response.

sara: pinging AcmeCorp with ETA and mitigation steps. will close thread when docs/CI/test PRs merged and customer confirms stable.
